name: Gemini APIs
certifications: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
tools: Google Gen AI SDK for Python (google-genai)
Google Gen AI SDK for JavaScript (@google/genai)
Vertex AI and Vertex AI Studio

beginner.summary: For developers who can write basic Python or JavaScript and are new to the Gemini API. Covers the difference between the Gemini Developer API in Google AI Studio and Gemini on Vertex AI, API keys, the Google Gen AI SDK, the Pro, Flash and Flash-Lite model tiers, the generateContent request and response, system instructions, generation parameters, chat, streaming, token counting, image, PDF, audio and video input, the Files API, JSON structured output, safety settings, error handling, free-tier rate limits, and a document question-answering capstone.
prerequisites: Writes and runs small Python 3 or Node.js scripts and installs packages with pip or npm
Understands HTTP requests, JSON bodies and status codes at the level of calling a REST API with curl
Has a Google account, a laptop with a terminal, and permission to create an API key in Google AI Studio
outcomes: Call the Gemini API from Python or JavaScript with the Google Gen AI SDK and from curl, and read every field of the response
Choose a model tier, set system instructions and generation parameters, and hold multi-turn and streaming conversations
Send images, PDFs, audio and video, and return validated JSON that matches a schema
Handle safety blocks, 4xx and 5xx errors and rate limits, and estimate token usage and cost before shipping

intermediate.summary: For developers who already call generateContent and want production features. Covers function calling declarations, tool loops, automatic function calling, calling modes and parallel calls, response schemas, thinking budgets, grounding with Google Search and URL context, code execution, embeddings with task types, retrieval-augmented generation, implicit and explicit context caching, media resolution, the Batch API, async concurrency and backoff, Vertex AI authentication and the move from AI Studio to Vertex AI, multimodal output, prompt patterns, usage metadata and cost tracking, and a grounded research assistant capstone.
prerequisites: Has completed the Gemini API beginner level or can already call generate_content, stream responses and read usage_metadata
Writes Python with type hints, virtual environments, pytest and async/await, or equivalent JavaScript
Can use the gcloud CLI and the Google Cloud console to select a project and enable an API
outcomes: Build tool-using applications with function calling, grounding, URL context and code execution, and control when each tool runs
Build semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation with Gemini embeddings and measure its retrieval quality
Reduce cost and latency with context caching, thinking settings, media resolution, async concurrency and the Batch API
Run the same application against the Developer API and Vertex AI, and track tokens and cost per request

advanced.summary: For engineers and architects who run Gemini workloads in production. Covers the Live API over WebSockets with audio, voice activity detection, tool use, session resumption and ephemeral tokens, agent loops with the Agent Development Kit and MCP tools, evaluation harnesses, prompt-injection defence and Model Armor, Vertex AI IAM, VPC Service Controls, CMEK, data residency and logging controls, quotas, Dynamic Shared Quota and Provisioned Throughput, cost and latency engineering, supervised tuning, BigQuery batch pipelines, Cloud Run deployment, observability, reliability and incident troubleshooting, and an enterprise platform capstone.
prerequisites: Has completed the intermediate Gemini API level or has shipped an application using function calling, grounding, caching or the Batch API
Operates services on Google Cloud: IAM roles and service accounts, Cloud Run or GKE, Cloud Logging and Cloud Storage
Reads and writes async Python or TypeScript, and knows WebSocket and HTTP/2 basics
outcomes: Build low-latency voice and video applications with the Live API, including session resumption and short-lived credentials
Secure Gemini workloads with IAM, VPC Service Controls, CMEK, data residency choices, input and output screening, and audit logs
Plan quota, Provisioned Throughput, routing, caching and batch capacity so that cost and latency targets are met and measured
Operate Gemini services with evaluation gates, observability, fallbacks, migration plans and an incident runbook
